tldr: For the declared randomized triangular current-status benchmark, the paper proves that the sharp normalized worst expected length of honest pure-private intervals for the exact implicit root contrast converges to the everywhere-private Gaussian decision value \(L_{\mathrm G}(c)\). The converse covers every original-data mechanism, and asymptotic attainment preserves exact original-record privacy and finite-index \(9/10\) honesty. The full-variation graph metric, reconstruction, all-kernel extraction, global cylinder extension, and effective calibration are proved. A terminating finite rational certification procedure also supplies an asymptotically optimal continuum mechanism sequence and a nonprivate certification procedure. The distinct open task is execution of that procedure at a positive budget. At \(c=1\), the only reported value bracket is the proved analytic bracket \(1.1167365664206967\ldots\le L_{\mathrm G}(1)\le1.2\), of width about \(0.0832634\); no \(10^{-3}\) bracket is claimed.
